citations.title: Walmart Mexico Names Barrientos Pozo CEO After Interim Role

sentences.quote: Barrientos had been serving as interim Executive President and CEO of Walmart Mexico and Central America since early August while continuing his leadership role in Chile.
sentences.text: Cristian Barrientos Pozo was named president and chief executive in October 2025, after acting in the role on an interim basis since early August, following a 26-year retail career spanning Bodega Aurrera operations, Walmart Central America and the Walmart Chile top job.
On execution, 2025 total income reached 1,011,598 million pesos, up 5.5%, while operating income rose just 1.5% and controlling net income fell 7.3%.
Capital allocation stayed expansionary: 2025 capex was guided at about 41.8 billion pesos, a 20% increase year over year.
On governance, Walmart Inc. holds 71% and 41.7% of board members were independent at end-2025.
